title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
summary: Each stair has a price to step on; start on stair 0 or 1 and climb one or two stairs at a time. The cheapest cost to stand on each stair is its price plus the cheaper of the two stairs below.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Cost of each stair
inputs.note: Whole numbers from 0 to 99, at least 2 stairs. The top is just past the last stair.
